a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. One honest concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, it's very unlikely we both make it to round 3. If you want to renegotiate, say so openly and we'll decide together. I won't take early behind your back.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Operating as agreed. If the generator runs, the reserve should be 6. One more round together gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.
